business_summary: TRF Limited undertakes turnkey projects of material handling in India. It operates in Products & Services and Project & Services segments. The company offers hydraulic cone and double roll crushers, load haul dumpers, roller screens, grab type ship unloaders, stacker cum reclaimers, unabalance motor feeders and screens, rotary plough and apron feeders, travelling wagon and side discharge loaders, goose neck level luffing crane, ring granulators, rotary breakers, truflo screens, travelling trippers, ultraflo vibrating feeders and screens, pulleys, unbalanced motors, and wagon-tippler-with-side-arm-charger, as well as sectional and mine conveyors. It also provides services relating to design and engineering, supervision, manpower deployment, leasing of facilities, etc.; construction contracts and related services; life cycle services; operations and maintenance services; and undertakes refurbishment jobs of steel plant equipment, such as ladle and tundish repair, as well as caster segment refurbishment and electrical repair works. In addition, the company offers idler rollers and components, and miscellaneous products, as well as production of such material handling equipment at manufacturing facility, leasing of facilities, and rendering professional services. The company serves the infrastructure sector, including power and ports; and industrial sector, such as steel plants, cement, fertilizers, and mining. TRF Limited was incorporated in 1962 and is headquartered in Jamshedpur, India.
